message.content: {"question":"A reversible thermal machine works with four heat sources. From the first source at temperature T₁ = 500 K, the machine absorbs the heat Q₁ = 5000 J. At the fourth source, at temperature T₄ = 280 K, the machine transfers the heat Q₄ = -1400 J. With the second and third sources, respectively at temperatures T₂ = 400 K and T₃ = 300 K, the machine exchanges the heat Q₂ and Q₃ = -Q₂. Calculate the efficiency of the thermal machine","options":{"A":"0.127","B":"0.327","C":"0.427","D":"0.227"},"correct":"B"}
